svg.text: Lane A — contracts/: two chains that never wait on each other
Group 0.1. Nothing in this lane depends on code; it is the only lane every other lane reads from.
A1 · R1 profile → CpmContent schema, R2 schema
3.0.1.4 has no predecessor either — A2 starts at the same moment as A1. 4.0.1.5 feeds 4.0.4.3 (lane C) and 4.0.6.1 (lane E); 3.0.1.4 feeds 3.0.4.2 (lane C).
Sample values are frozen here, not derived downstream: distance 25.03 = hypot(25.0, 1.2) per convention F7, sender.speed nullable per F1.
